system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application'

Resources:
  DatabaseCluster:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBCluster'
    Properties:
      EngineMode: serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '13.8'
      MasterUsername: !Sub 'saasapp${AWS::Region}'
      MasterUserPassword: !Sub 'saasapp${AWS::Region}password'
      DatabaseName: saasappdb
      Port: 5432
      ScalingConfiguration:
        AutoPause: true
        MaxCapacity: 64
        MinCapacity: 4
        SecondsUntilAutoPause: 300
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup'
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Sub 'saasapp-${AWS::Region}-db-subnet-group'
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: DB Subnet Group for SaaS application
      SubnetIds: !Split [',', !Sub '${SubnetId1},${SubnetId2},${SubnetId3}']

  DBSecurityGroup:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup'
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security Group for SaaS application database
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  DBSecurityGroupIngress:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress'
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref DBSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 5432
      ToPort: 5432
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

Parameters:
  SubnetId1:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id'
    Description: Subnet ID 1 for DB Subnet Group
  SubnetId2:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id'
    Description: Subnet ID 2 for DB Subnet Group
  SubnetId3:
    Type: 'AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id'
    Description: Subnet ID 3 for DB Subnet Group

Outputs:
  DatabaseClusterIdentifier:
    Value: !Ref DatabaseCluster
    Description: Database Cluster Identifier
  DatabaseClusterEndpoint:
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseCluster.EndpointAddress
    Description: Database Cluster Endpoint Address
  DatabaseClusterPort:
    Value: !GetAtt DatabaseCluster.Port
    Description: Database Cluster Port
